scripts.build: rm -rf dist && cd ../.. && cross-env NODE_ENV=production swc apps/backend/src libraries/nestjs-libraries/src libraries/helpers/src -d apps/backend/dist --config-file apps/backend/.swcrc
scripts.start: node ../../var/docker/runtime-diagnostics.cjs backend ./dist/apps/backend/src/main.js && TS_NODE_PROJECT=../../tsconfig.base.json TS_NODE_BASEURL=$(pwd)/dist node -r ../../load-env.cjs -r tsconfig-paths/register --experimental-require-module ./dist/apps/backend/src/main.js
